title: Add --allow-large-images to axondeepseg_morphometrics
prompt:
`axondeepseg_morphometrics` crashes with PIL's `DecompressionBombError` on very large microscopy
images, even though AxonDeepSeg already has a mechanism for this: `ads_utils.imread()` accepts an
`allow_large_images` argument, and the segmentation CLI (`AxonDeepSeg/segment.py`) exposes it as an
`--allow-large-images` flag.

Add the same `--allow-large-images` flag to `axondeepseg_morphometrics`
(AxonDeepSeg/morphometrics/launch_morphometrics_computation.py) and make sure every image or mask read
during the morphometrics computation honors it, including the colored image with axon index numbers
generated in AxonDeepSeg/postprocessing.py. Keep the default behavior unchanged when the flag is not
passed. Add unit tests covering the new flag in the existing test files.
